games.title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
games.description: Radial ball-deflection survival game for 2–10 contestants. One local player can defend a gate with movement, Magnet, Pulse and Run while AI bots fill remaining seats; arena size is adjustable and phone/network transport is not yet integrated.

source.provenance: Imported unchanged from edmondsonedits/CALLBACK commit ed09d25b690b36b397516e4d77437e3dd21247c8 (game-modes/royal-ballistix/index.html). Upstream repository license: Apache-2.0.
